title: Chapter 67: You Can See Her?
html:
Chen Ge accepted the document. The first line read: New Century Park Underground Parking Lot Usage Agreement.

After flipping through it, Chen Ge did not find any clauses related to rental. “Director Luo, is the document missing something?”

“Never seen a rent-free agreement before? I’ve stamped it, so all it needs is your signature. It remains valid until the park closes. Make good use of the space, and don’t let me down.” Director Luo’s mood seemed much improved. He poured himself another cup of tea. “You’ll be busy from now on, so I won’t keep you any longer.”

Chen Ge left the office clutching the contract, still unable to believe he had secured the park’s underground lot without paying a cent.

The contract granted him free use of the parking lot for as long as the park remained open. Chen Ge assumed Director Luo could afford such generosity because New Century Park would close in two or three months, once the new park in Eastern Jiujiang opened.

The underground lot is a third the size of the park. It may be abandoned, but getting it rent-free is still an incredible windfall!

Chen Ge’s luck had improved since he dealt with the mirror monster. He had received a medal, the reward money was on its way, and the expansion problem was solved. Everything was looking up.

Does getting rid of unclean things improve my luck?He did not seriously believe in such a coincidence; the thought merely amused him.

Back at the Haunted House, Chen Ge began the day’s work. Xiao Wan donned the park uniform and sold tickets outside while he prowled Murder by Midnight as Doctor Skull-cracker, chasing visitors through the scenario.

At five that afternoon, Chen Ge emerged from the Haunted House. He let Xiao Wan leave early, then prepared to collect his reward.

For the first time in my life, my bank balance will reach five figures. That deserves a celebration tonight.Chen Ge changed into clean clothes in the staff breakroom. As he was about to leave, he noticed a small rag doll beside the bed, most of her body tucked beneath it as though she were playing hide-and-seek.

It’s still daylight, and you’re already out.He suddenly remembered what Captain Yan had told him that morning. The old man’s condition is getting worse, and he has no family left. I should visit him.

Chen Ge poked Xiaoxiao on her stomach before putting her in his pocket and leaving the Haunted House.

At 6:15 p.m., Chen Ge left the bureau with his 36,000 RMB reward—less than he had expected.

After buying a fruit basket and some milk, Chen Ge headed to Jiujiang People’s Hospital. A nurse led him to a third-floor ward, where he found a familiar face beside the old man’s bed.

“Inspector Lee, why are you here?”

Inspector Lee sat beside the bed, carefully spooning porridge into the old man’s mouth.

“This is strange. Why do I keep running into you everywhere?” Inspector Lee adjusted the towel over the old man’s chest. “After I finally got some sleep, the chief took one look at me and assigned me lighter duty for the day.”

“Law enforcement even cares about things like this?”

“The old man was injured while under our protection. Until we find him a caregiver, looking after him is the least we can do.”

Inspector Lee offered him two more spoonfuls, but the old man had no appetite. He set down the spoon and gestured toward Chen Ge in the doorway. “Sir, this is the young man who gave us the evidence that solved the case. He’s also the one who called us that night and saved your life.”

When he saw Chen Ge, the old man’s arm that was still movable twitched, but it was unclear what he was trying to communicate.

“If anything, I should thank you. If you hadn’t broken that bowl at Ping An Apartments to warn me, I might never have realized something was wrong.” Chen Ge set the fruit and milk on the counter. The old man looked as though he might slip away at any moment, and the sight shook him. “Inspector Lee, would you mind giving us a minute? I’d like to speak with him in private.”

Inspector Lee did not know what Chen Ge intended, but he trusted him enough to leave without question. Once the door closed, Chen Ge drew the doll from his pocket. “Sir, I brought Xiaoxiao to see you.”

At first, the old man gave no response. Then his clouded eyes settled on the rag doll. His pupils trembled, and a rasp like air leaking from a broken bellows escaped his lips. His one mobile arm reached toward her.

“You can see her?”

Chen Ge had brought Xiaoxiao to visit her family, never imagining the old man would actually see the spirit possessing the doll.

He hurried to the bedside and gently placed the doll in the old man’s arm. The frail limb tightened around Xiaoxiao, and the old man gradually calmed.

Legend says that, near the end of life, people can glimpse the other world.

The black phone in Chen Ge’s pocket vibrated. He exited the room to give the grandfather and the granddaughter their privacy.

“I heard noises in there. What did you tell him? Listen, he’s extremely fragile. Too much of a shock could kill him.” Inspector Lee waited outside the door, ready to rush in at the slightest sign of trouble.

“I only brought him the person he wanted to see most.” Chen Ge sat on a corridor bench and checked the black phone. The affection page showed that Yin Xiaoxiao’s rating had risen from ‘Slightly Favorable Opinion’ to ‘Can Be Trusted.’

The little fella is the most unique Baleful Specter I’ve ever met. I wonder what will happen when I raise her affection level to the maximum.Chen Ge returned the phone to his pocket and leaned against the wall. “Uncle San Bao, don’t worry, the old sir will recover.”

“You sure are optimistic.”

By the time Chen Ge and Inspector Lee returned, the old man’s condition had stabilized. He waved at Chen Ge, though no one understood what he meant.

After nodding to the nurse, Chen Ge left with Xiaoxiao. The little spirit had retreated inside the doll, apparently asleep.

After getting a quick dinner at the roadside stall, Chen Ge rushed back to the Haunted House.

I still haven’t accepted today’s Daily Mission. I wonder if there’s still time.

Among the three Daily Missions, the most suitable was definitely the expansion. All he needed to do was choose the direction of expansion and a general location.
